name: Mercury
description: Innermost rocky planet with extreme temperatures, no atmosphere, heavily cratered.

name: Venus
description: Hot greenhouse world with thick CO2 atmosphere, volcanic surface, retrograde rotation.

name: Earth
description: Habitable blue planet with oceans, continents, diverse life, and Terran Directorate homeworld—fractured post-2035 Attack.

name: Mars
description: Red desert world with polar ice caps, ancient volcanoes, and potential for human colonies.

name: Jupiter
description: Largest planet with Great Red Spot storm, 95+ moons, strong magnetic field.

name: Saturn
description: Ringed beauty with 146 moons, hexagonal storm at north pole.

name: Uranus
description: Tilted sideways with faint rings, 27 moons, extreme seasons.

name: Neptune
description: Windy blue world with Great Dark Spot, 14 moons, Triton retrograde moon.

name: Felskern
description: Hot, non-habitable world with a thin atmosphere, used as a mining outpost for metals and resources supporting the trade hub (~3.8 solar flux). Confirmed as HD 86728 b.

name: Ninurta
description: Saturn-like, named after the Assyrian god of agriculture and war. Supports rimward trade logistics with resource-rich icy moons (3–5, ~0.01–0.1 Earth masses) hosting fuel/trade stations.

name: Stahlburgh
description: Alpine Prime, Felgenland Union capital with Pangaea-like supercontinent (~120 million km²), alpine/temperate biomes (mean 10–11°C), coniferous forests, grassy highlands. Low axial tilt (10°) for stable seasons. Hosts rugged colonies, mining, administrative centers.

name: Eisenwald
description: Jungle Moon orbiting Stahlburgh, vibrant trade port with biodiverse markets. Hothouse equatorial jungles (30–40°C), tropical/sub-tropical (20–30°C), temperate poles (5–10°C). Thick greenhouse atmosphere (1.7 atm, CO₂/CH₄/H₂O), tidal heating (~0.15 W/m²), moderate tilt (~25°).

name: Ashur
description: Jupiter-like, named after the Assyrian god of war and empire. Orbital platforms serve as trade gateways, multiple icy moons (~0.01 Earth masses) for resource extraction (volatiles). Minimal eclipse impact (~30–50 minutes every ~8.1 years).

name: Eiswelt
description: Neptune-like, mined for volatiles to support trade hub.
